subject: Marketplace addendum — audit access & pass-through language
messages:
From: Tom Sutherland <tom@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-retail.com, legal@acme-retail.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace addendum — audit access & pass-through language

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for sending over the marketplace addendum draft. Our procurement team reviewed Section 6 (Pass-through and Audit) and flagged two items they need clarified before we can route this to PO:

- Does Redwood expect direct on-site auditor access to our systems under the pass-through clause?
- If so, can we limit scope to billing and usage records only or provide an alternate attestation process?

They attached a short questionnaire and asked whether Redwood will accept a redacted report or if an external audit is required.

ATTACHMENTS: procurement-questionnaire.pdf (pdf), acme-standard-sla.pdf (pdf)

Can we get a short note on acceptable evidence and a suggested alternative clause? Procurement would like to close this week.

Best,
Tom
Head of Vendor Ops
Acme Retail

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Sutherland <tom@acme-retail.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — audit access & pass-through language

Tom,

Thanks — appreciate the quick flag. Short answer: we do not allow broad on-site auditor access for marketplace listings. We can provide an alternative that meets procurement's needs:

- Limited scope review: billing/usage ledgers and redacted access to logs relevant to billing for the period in question.
- Formal attestation option: Redwood Legal can provide a signed attestation and summarized redacted reports plus an independent accounting reconciliation (if needed).

I've looped in KarThik (sales ops) and Laura (legal) to propose specific language. KarThik — can you propose trade-friendly wording we can send to Acme? Laura — if you want to send a short redline, we can include it with the DocuSign packet.

Quick call would help if procurement insists on auditor presence. What's your availability Wednesday?

Cheers,
Marissa
Senior Partner Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Marketplace_Addendum_v3.docx (docx) - initial draft]

From: KarThik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Sutherland <tom@acme-retail.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — audit access & pass-through language

Tom / Marissa — tagging in proposed commercial compromise before legal redlines. We can't accept unfettered on-site audits for marketplace partners due to multi-tenant constraints. Suggested compromise for Section 6:

1) Auditor access: "No direct physical or remote auditor access to Redwood production systems shall be permitted. Instead, Redwood will, upon reasonable written request and subject to confidentiality obligations, provide: (a) billing and usage ledgers for the requested period; (b) a Redwood-signed attestation covering the requested metrics; and (c) a redacted summary of logs relevant to billing reconciliation."

2) Independent accounting: "If Customer reasonably requires third-party validation, Redwood will cooperate with a mutually agreeable independent auditor limited to documentary review and remote verification of billing records only; such auditor must execute Redwood's standard NDA and may not access protected multi-tenant data."

I attached a quick mark-up of the addendum (Redwood_Marketplace_Addendum_v3.docx) with inline comments. 

We should avoid language that exposes internal telemetry or raw logs. Laura — please advise on whether the NDA + scope carveouts are sufficient or if we need additional wording around remediation/notice.

Ben — FYI on commercial acceptability and whether this impacts the billing flow (hoping not).

-Karthik
Director, Channel Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Marketplace_Addendum_v3.docx (docx) - redlines by karthik]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tom Sutherland <tom@acme-retail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — audit access & pass-through language

Tom, Marissa,

Thanks — I've reviewed Karthik's suggested compromise and made a couple of legal clarifications in the attached redline. Key points we added:

- Explicit prohibition on access to multi-tenant production systems and telemetry.
- Defined "billing records" and limited timeframe for any review to the twelve (12) months prior to request.
- NDA and scope limits for any third-party auditor, plus prohibition on exfiltration of customer PII or Redwood internal metrics.
- Remedies: if an auditor uncovers material misuse of billing data, Redwood will cooperate to remediate and provide reasonable additional evidence; otherwise, attestation stands as final for billing reconciliation.

Please see the proposed paragraph to insert in Section 6: "For clarity, Customer shall not be granted direct access to Redwood's production environment or any internal telemetry. Redwood will provide, upon written request, billing records and a signed attestation covering billing metrics for the specified period, and may, at Redwood's discretion and subject to a mutually executed NDA, permit a remote documentary review by an independent auditor limited to billing records. The parties agree that any such review shall not permit access to multi-tenant raw telemetry or PII and shall be limited to documentary evidence for reconciliation purposes."

We're happy to go to DocuSign once Acme confirms the alternative is acceptable. If procurement insists on on-site audit as a hard requirement, escalate and we'll look at carve-outs or limited physical review at a Redwood-approved facility with strict controls (unlikely preferable).

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Marketplace_Addendum_v3.docx (docx) - redline by legal]

From: Tom Sutherland <tom@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-retail.com, legal@acme-retail.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — audit access & pass-through language

Marissa, Karthik, Laura — this is helpful, thanks. Procurement and legal prefer the attestation + limited documentary review approach you outlined. They asked for the redline and DocuSign-ready language so we can turn this into a PO by Friday.

Two small asks from procurement:
- Can the attestation include a reconciliation table for the prior 6 months?
- Will Redwood accept a clause allowing a single remote documentary review by a mutually approved accounting firm, subject to Redwood's NDA?

If you can send a DocuSign-ready addendum with Laura's paragraph plus the 6-month reconciliation note, we'll push this internally and sign. Appreciate the quick turnaround — looks like this should close this week.

Best,
Tom
Head of Vendor Ops
Acme Retail
[Attachment: procurement-approval-email-thread.pdf (pdf) - procurement confirmation]
